guide.summary: Water split in two by a wall, with six fine membranes as the only way through.
guide.biology: A fine membrane lets dissolved food and signals seep through slowly but stops every living thing.
guide.rules: All water. An impermeable wall along x 64, except at y 61 to 66, where six fine membrane edges join the two sides; no stones. A fine membrane passes dissolved amounts and activity at 25 % and blocks organisms, viruses and deposits. Light 0.8, warmth 0.5, oxygen 0.8, carbon dioxide 0.5, nutrient 0.10 and sugar 0.02 in every open cell. Lid open; fixed light.
guide.example: Feed one side and watch what reaches the other through the membranes.
